description: This file is an example HTML webpage demonstrating the integration and configuration of the TinyMCE rich text editor. It includes scripts for initializing TinyMCE, callback functions, and example content with a form and textarea.

methods.name: fileBrowserCallBack
methods.description: A callback function invoked by TinyMCE when customizing the file browser dialog. It displays an alert with parameters and sets a URL in a form element.
